draft.subject: Re: Checking in on Summit Systems' setup
draft.body:
Hi Aisha,

Thanks for the quick reply — glad things are going smoothly so far.

One thing that tends to make Wrenfield click faster: bringing in a teammate. A teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time. Projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so it's easy for others to pick up where you left off.

If it's useful, I'm happy to hop on a short call this week and help you get your team set up — just name a time that suits.

Best,
Nadia
